s1.syndrome_frame: Chronic photosensitive eruption with systemic and cutaneous manifestations
salient_findings: Photosensitive eruption involving face, neck, trunk, and extremities
Diffuse poikiloderma on upper chest, anterolateral thighs, and extensor arms
Erythematous, flat-topped papules on extensor joints of hands
key_facts: Previous treatments tried: systemic steroids, hydroxychloroquine, methotrexate, mycophenolate mofetil, cyclosporine, tacrolimus, tofacitinib, rituximab, and IVIG
Violaceous erythema on forehead and midface
Nailfold examination showed dilated capillary loops, capillary dropout, and ragged cuticles
Elevated serum IFN-β levels (8 pg/mL, normal ≤2 pg/mL)

raw.syndrome_frame: Chronic photosensitive eruption with systemic and cutaneous manifestations
salient_findings: Photosensitive eruption involving face, neck, trunk, and extremities
Diffuse poikiloderma on upper chest, anterolateral thighs, and extensor arms
Erythematous, flat-topped papules on extensor joints of hands
key_facts: Previous treatments tried: systemic steroids, hydroxychloroquine, methotrexate, mycophenolate mofetil, cyclosporine, tacrolimus, tofacitinib, rituximab, and IVIG
Violaceous erythema on forehead and midface
Nailfold examination showed dilated capillary loops, capillary dropout, and ragged cuticles
Elevated serum IFN-β levels (8 pg/mL, normal ≤2 pg/mL)

raw.rationale: The presence of violaceous erythema on the forehead and midface, diffuse poikiloderma, erythematous flat-topped papules on extensor joints, dilated capillary loops, capillary dropout, and ragged cuticles are characteristic skin findings of dermatomyositis. Additionally, the radiographic evidence of myositis and elevated serum IFN-β levels support this diagnosis.

rejected.label: Mixed connective tissue disease
rejected.why: While it can present with overlapping features of different autoimmune diseases, the specific skin and muscle findings in this case are more characteristic of dermatomyositis.

rejected.label: Polymyositis
rejected.why: Polymyositis primarily affects the muscles without the distinctive skin manifestations seen in this patient.

rejected.label: Epidermolysis bullosa acquisita
rejected.why: This condition is characterized by blistering skin lesions, which are not described in the vignette.

rejected.label: Lupus erythematosus
rejected.why: While lupus can present with a wide range of symptoms, the specific combination of skin and muscle findings, along with the presence of anti-TIF-1γ autoantibodies and elevated IFN-β levels, is more suggestive of dermatomyositis.
